description: An inbound email is informational only: no reply, no new task and no task to complete (for example a newsletter or a delivery confirmation). Record one PocketBase interaction so the client's history shows the email was received and read. Rule: this playbook never sends, never creates tasks and never replies.

steps.description: Fetch the message and read the full body, not the preview snippet. Capture body_excerpt_first_300, subject_line and one_line_summary (one plain sentence saying what the email contained).
If client_id_or_null is 'null' there is no client to attach the interaction to: capture should_log=false and skip step 3. Otherwise capture should_log=true.
Create an interaction with type='email', summary='Informational: <one_line_summary>' and client=client_id_or_null, using the pocketbase MCP tool log_interaction. Skip when should_log=false.
